subject.title: fix(nodes): restore Mac app allowlist execution

question: Should this PR be accepted as the canonical Gateway-side fix for macOS companion nodes without `system.run.prepare`, or should maintainers require an app-side prepare implementation instead?
rationale: The patch looks correct, but it changes a remote-exec approval and allowlist boundary where maintainer intent is needed before treating the legacy transport behavior as acceptable.

options.title: Accept Gateway-side validated preview forwarding
options.body: Merge this PR once exact-head CI and maintainer/security review confirm the preview is only forwarded when it matches the bound argv.

options.title: Require Mac app prepare support
options.body: Pause this PR and move the fix to macOS companion `system.run.prepare` support if maintainers want the node owner to produce the transport payload.

options.title: Ask for broader legacy-node proof
options.body: Keep the PR open and request additional non-Mac legacy-node evidence if maintainers believe other nodes without prepare may rely on canonical `rawCommand` text.

recommendation.title: Accept Gateway-side validated preview forwarding
recommendation.body: Merge this PR once exact-head CI and maintainer/security review confirm the preview is only forwarded when it matches the bound argv.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete authored this fix and recent merged node exec approval command work, making him the best available routing owner for the security-boundary choice.
